content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for HLL Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by HLL Lifecare (HLL) for various pharmacist positions across multiple grade levels in Nagpur, Maharashtra.

faq.question: Q2. What is the mode of application for HLL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Eligible candidates directly attend the interview at the designated venue on the scheduled date without prior online submission.

faq.question: Q3. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview for HLL Lifecare Pharmacist recruitment is officially scheduled to take place on 29 September 2026 along with registration.

faq.question: Q4. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: The recruitment drive offers multiple positions distributed across Assistant Pharmacist and Pharmacist Grade I to IV roles, totaling 5 posts.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a D.Pharm or B.Pharm degree, with varying years of post-qualification experience in retail pharmacy depending on the specific grade applied for.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts is 37 years as on 1 September 2026, with age relaxations applicable for SC, ST, OBC, and PwD candidates.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for HLL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category including General, OBC, SC, and ST candidates as per the official notification details.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, category certificates, self-attested photocopies, and passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for HLL Lifecare Pharmacist positions consists of a Written Test followed by a personal Interview conducted at the venue.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the walk-in interview take place?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held in Nagpur, Maharashtra (Pincode: 440025). Detailed venue address can be verified directly from the official notification PDF.
